questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Two forces $A$ and $B$ whose magnitude are in the ratio $3: 5$ give a resultant of $28\text{N}$. If the angle of their inclination is ${60}^{°},$ then the magnitude of force $B$ will be ----- $N$.
questions.solution:
Let $A$ and $B$ be the two forces.

Then $A = 3x; B = 5x, R = 28N$ and $\theta = {60}^{°}$ .

We know that $R = \sqrt{{A}^{2} + {B}^{2} + 2ABcos\theta}$

$⇒ 28 = \sqrt{{\left(3x\right)}^{2} + {\left(5x\right)}^{2} + 2\left(3x\right)\left(5x\right)cos{60}^{°}}$

$= \sqrt{9{x}^{2} + 25{x}^{2} + 15{x}^{2}} = 7x$

$⇒ x = \dfrac{28}{7} = 4$

Hence, force $B = 5 \times 4 = 20\text{N}$
